title: TMNT
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 2155 (addresses converted to GBA bus addresses)

widgets.text:
Each turtle has a unique move
Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello and Michelangelo each lead some acts; switch turtles where the game allows

Bosses at stage ends
Acts end with boss fights; the final blow of Act 7 closes the story

rows: the Turtles' Lair, the Streets and the Rooftops; levels include a construction site, a retro diner and a tower with garden and lobby

widgets.text:
Health
Health refills from pizza-style pickups and between acts

Hidden items
Trophy Room and a Music Player unlock with progress

Levels cleared
Seven acts, each with cut scenes, then the conclusion and credits

notes: RA documents most addresses for the EU release only; the US-confirmed ones are turtle EXP and difficulty
